symptom: PC-1 cannot ping Server-A in VLAN 30; gateway ping works
topology_note: PC-1 is in VLAN 10 (192.168.10.10/24). Server-A is in VLAN 30 (192.168.30.50/24). Gateway is Router-1.
show_outputs:
Router-1# show ip route
192.168.10.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0.10
192.168.20.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0.20
Switch-1# show interfaces trunk
Port Mode Encapsulation Status Native vlan
Gi0/1 on 802.1q trunking 1
